articles.title: Reset a technician's password
articles.body: Admins reset a tech's password from Team > Technicians > select the tech > Reset password. The tech gets an email link valid for 60 minutes. If the tech is locked out after 5 failed attempts, the lock clears after 15 minutes or an admin can unlock from the same screen.

articles.title: Connect QuickBooks Online
articles.body: Go to Settings > Integrations > QuickBooks Online and click Connect. Invoices sync every 15 minutes. If invoices duplicate, disconnect and reconnect the integration and turn on 'Match by invoice number'; contact support with two example invoice numbers if duplicates continue.

articles.title: Add technicians and seats
articles.body: Admins add techs from Team > Technicians > Add technician. Starter includes up to 5 techs and Pro up to 25. Adding techs beyond your plan prompts an upgrade. Enterprise accounts can add seats through their account manager.

articles.title: Set up recurring maintenance visits
articles.body: Open a customer, choose Service plans > New plan, pick the interval (monthly, quarterly, yearly) and the visit template. Fernhill creates the visits 30 days ahead and puts them on the dispatch board unassigned.

articles.title: Mobile app: photos and offline mode
articles.body: The tech app stores jobs offline and syncs when it reconnects. Photo attachments are limited to 20 MB each. If the app closes when attaching a photo, update to the latest app version and make sure the app has camera and storage permission.

articles.title: Update your billing card and download invoices
articles.body: Account owners update the card under Settings > Billing > Payment method. Invoices for every month are under Settings > Billing > Invoices and can be downloaded as PDF. For W-9 forms or PO-formatted invoices, the Billing team responds within 2 business days.

articles.title: Change or cancel your plan
articles.body: Account owners can request a plan change or cancellation from Settings > Billing > Plan, or by replying to Support. The Billing team confirms the effective date and any balance in writing. Support agents can't change contract terms.

articles.title: Service status and outages
articles.body: Live service status is at status.fernhill.example. During an incident, updates post there every 30 minutes. If the dispatch board won't load, check the status page first, then try a hard refresh.

articles.title: Import customers from a CSV file
articles.body: Go to Customers > Import, download the template, fill in name, address, phone and email columns, and upload the file. Imports of up to 10,000 rows finish in a few minutes. Duplicates are matched by email.

articles.title: GPS tracking and location permissions
articles.body: GPS tracking shows tech locations on the dispatch map while a tech is clocked in. Each tech must allow location access 'While using the app' on their phone. Admins can turn tracking off per tech under Team > Technicians.

articles.title: Request a feature
articles.body: Feature ideas go to the public roadmap at roadmap.fernhill.example, where customers can vote. Product reviews the top-voted ideas every month. Support can add your vote and your use case for you.

articles.title: Job notes and history
articles.body: Job notes save automatically when a tech taps Done. Every edit is kept in the job's History tab, including deleted notes, for 90 days. If notes look missing, check History before re-entering them.
